# ambient rna removal using cellbender
# note: install cellbender into its own venv to avoid conflicts


```{python}
import os
import pandas as pd
import subprocess

carpall_meta = pd.read_csv(
    "/Users/rmhadgm/OneDrive - University College London/Ghorashian_group/carpall_integration/carpall_metadata_organised.csv"
).drop(columns=["Unnamed: 0"])

base_dir = "/Volumes/ritd-ag-project-rd01k9-tacco78/scRNAseq data - CARPALL/"

gex_ids = set(carpall_meta["GEX_id"].astype(str))

file_names = os.listdir(base_dir)

file_names = [
    f for f in file_names
    if any(gid in f for gid in gex_ids)
]

file_names = [
    f for f in file_names
    if "cellranger302" not in f
]

file_names = [
    f for f in file_names
    if "vdj" not in f.lower()
]

for folder in sorted(file_names):

    sample_dir = os.path.join(base_dir, folder)

    input_file = os.path.join(
        sample_dir,
        "raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5"
    )

    output_file = os.path.join(
        sample_dir,
        "cellbender_output.h5"
    )

    if not os.path.exists(input_file):
        print(f"{folder}: no raw matrix found")
        continue

    if os.path.exists(output_file):
        print(f"{folder}: already processed")
        continue

    print(f"Running CellBender on {folder}")

    subprocess.run(
        [
            "/Users/rmhadgm/venvs/cellbender/bin/cellbender",
            "remove-background",
            "--input", input_file,
            "--output", output_file,
        ],
        check=True
    )
```
